content.text:
Based on the facilities described on the schools’ websites, **UNIS Hanoi, British International School (BIS) Hanoi, and British Vietnamese International School (BVIS) Hanoi** are strong options for both sports and the arts. There isn’t a clear independent ranking, so the best fit depends on which facilities matter most.

| School | Sports facilities | Arts facilities |
|---|---|---|
| **UNIS Hanoi** | 25-metre, six-lane all-season pool and children’s pool; large covered sports court; fields and tennis courts. | Centre for the Arts, music and drama spaces, film room, and a **400-seat theatre**. |
| **BIS Hanoi** | 25-metre indoor pool, sports hall, full-sized Astroturf pitch, and air-conditioned dance studio. | **200-seat theatre**, auditorium, and dedicated music and drama suites. |
| **BVIS Hanoi** | Heated 25-metre pool, two multi-purpose sports halls, Astroturf pitch, and climbing wall. | Performing arts centre, outdoor performance stage, and **300-seat auditorium**. |

**Quick guide**
- **UNIS Hanoi:** especially compelling if a large theatre and broad campus facilities are priorities.
- **BIS Hanoi:** a well-rounded choice, with a strong mix of indoor and outdoor sport and dedicated performance spaces.
- **BVIS Hanoi:** stands out for its climbing wall, two sports halls, and outdoor performance stage.

These details come from the schools’ own facility descriptions, so it’s worth confirming what’s currently open and available to students during a campus visit—particularly as UNIS describes ongoing sports-centre development. Sources: [UNIS campus visit](https://www.unishanoi.org/admissions/visit-our-campus), [BIS facilities](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bis-hanoi/campus/facilities), [BVIS facilities](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bvis-hanoi/campus/facilities).
